{{Infobox auto}}
'''Sulfur deposit''' is the renamed deepslate redstone ore.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Sulfur deposits come from the vanilla lower redstone veins, which the pack leaves unchanged: 8 attempts per chunk in veins of up to 8 blocks, from the world bottom up to y=−32, most common at the bottom. Since {{Version|1.12.8-beta}} the upper redstone veins generate between y=16 and y=56 as [[fossil]]s, so they place a sulfur deposit only where they meet deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/ore_redstone.json}}</ref> Before, those upper veins ran from the world bottom to y=15 and turned all the deepslate they reached into sulfur deposits, so sulfur deposits are now rarer.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1–2 [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunks]]. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_redstone_ore.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
Since {{Version|1.12.8-beta}}, a player standing on a sulfur deposit gives off puffs of noxious gas particles, as on [[Sulfurous Hellstone|sulfurous hellstone]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/emits_sulfur_particles.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/particle/sulfurous_hellstone.mcfunction}}</ref> The block has three textures of yellow veins in deepslate, which the game picks between at random for each block (the first half as often as the other two).<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/blockstates/deepslate_redstone_ore.json}}</ref>
